units.translation: Go in flight to your defense.

Speaking clearly these bloodless flights.
Or to punish him, living, as a dishonored exile, in the same way as this man, by driving him out.
Now you are judging exile from the city for me.
Both having the same flight, flight from their homes.
To be dishonored with public exile.

Concerning the Danaids fleeing the marriage to be entered into with the sons of Aegyptus. In M, αὐτογένητον [self-born] (αὐτογενῆ τὸν [self-born the] Turnebus) φυξάνοραν [man-fleeing], with one letter after pu erased and λ written above (which indicates φυλαξαν-), and in the margin γρ. φυξάνοραν [man-fleeing].
But self-born, in flight from men (so the Bamberg manuscript), blaming the marriage of the sons of Aegyptus as impious.
